summary: Spain combines government auctions with one of the world's largest corporate PPA markets, and has streamlined permits for solar and wind. Grid access is the pinch point, with strict milestones that can cancel permits and tenders for capacity at congested nodes.

access.reason: Government auctions drive renewable growth, and corporate PPAs are increasingly used for wind and solar.

ownership.reason: Transfers with non-residents are free, though a 1991 decree lets the government limit them in exceptional circumstances.

build.reason: Grid permits expire automatically if projects miss milestones set in 2020, and capacity at some nodes is allocated by tender.

direction.reason: Permitting for solar and wind has been streamlined and grid capacity increased.

access.reason: Spain ranks among the top countries for corporate PPAs.

ownership.reason: Transfers are free except in exceptional circumstances.

build.reason: Grid access milestones and node tenders also apply to corporate projects.

direction.reason: Corporate PPAs are expected to drive further growth.

events.title: New capacity market pays storage and flexible demand for availability
